---
title: Catchable JSON errors
format: html
filters:
  - at: pre-ast
    type: lua
    path: issue-15226.lua
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'ERROR \('
        negate: true
---

JSON encoding and decoding errors are catchable from a pre-AST Lua filter.
